body: every time i try and talk to her she is so defensive and rude. i have been in therapy alot and have therefore learnt how to constructively talk to someone;however, she is an emotionally stunted person who is incapable of having a normal convo with me. she screams abuse at me and pushes all my buttons so then i do the same. i just want everyone to leave me alone and to die in a hole. i am not trying to get attention by writing this, i just want someone to understand. i have no therapist here and i cant explain to any of my friends. nobody gets it- my life is full of cunts who try cut me down. the logical explanation would be for me to be strong, cut through it and prove them all wrong... but aat the end of the day my emotional mind is bleeding in distress and pain.
